hook: Metro + bus monthly pass drops from ₹8,500 to *₹4,000*
hook_b: Metro + bus monthly pass drops from ₹8,500 to *₹4,000*
tldr: From Nov 8, the joint Metro-TGSRTC pass costs ₹275 a day or ₹4,000 a month.

beats.what: Transport Minister Ponnam Prabhakar cut joint Metro-TGSRTC pass prices on Friday, Nov 6.
beats.why: The government says it wants public transport to be affordable.
beats.care: Daily users save ₹125 a day; monthly holders save ₹4,500 from Nov 8.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Daily pass: ₹400 → ₹275, up to 4 single journeys a day. Monthly pass: ₹8,500 → ₹4,000 (₹3,000 Metro + ₹1,000 bus), up to 50 round trips. Where to buy and which stations: not announced in the report yet.

cards.q: ₹4,000 monthly Metro + bus pass: will you buy it?

viz.verdict: Three-quarters of the pass is Metro

cover.label: Monthly Metro + bus pass from Nov 8

insight: The monthly pass gets cheaper by more than half: ₹4,500 saved.

learn.t: Common pass = one ticket valid on both Hyderabad Metro and TGSRTC buses.

watch: Sale counters and stations covered, once TGSRTC and Metro publish details.

sources.name: Siasat
sources.title: Telangana to cut Hyderabad Metro-RTC Pass prices from November 8

fact: Hyderabad's Metro-plus-bus monthly pass falls to *₹4,000* from ₹8,500 on November 8
twist: The new daily pass is ₹275: ₹200 goes to Metro, ₹75 to TGSRTC buses.
